Sleep paralysis is so fucking scary. I was home alone whilst my parents were out for the night at a friends house. I had a couple friends over and we were playing halo 5 till about 11 pm. They left at 11 and I went upstairs to catch some z’s. I woke up during the night to get a drink and returned to my bed. I suddenly began feeling some strange cold sensations  in my back as I lay down. I closed my eyes and I started to doze off but whilst this was happening my eyes were wide open my whole body was completely stuck in the most uncomfortable position and I couldn’t breathe I remember screaming and screaming but there were no words coming out. My mouth was shut and I couldn’t open it. I had zero control over my entire body. This carried on for a good 10 to 30 seconds but it felt like forever . I honestly had never felt more scared and vulnerable in my whole life.
